title: Kingdom Two Crowns Music
description: Transform your world with the cinematic music of Kingdom Two Crowns. 40+ tracks covering every biome and dimension.
body:
# Kingdom Two Crowns: Shogun, Dead Lands & Classic Music

Transform your Minecraft experience into a cinematic journey. This pack completely replaces the vanilla soundtrack with a curated selection of atmospheric, traditional Japanese-inspired, and hauntingly ethereal compositions from the Kingdom series.

> **Note:** This pack uses the `"replace": true` function to ensure that no vanilla tracks (including Lena Raine or Aaron Cherof) interfere with the custom atmosphere.

---

## 🛠️ Technical Details

* **Pack Version:** 1.0
* **Compatibility:** Minecraft 1.21.x (Java Edition)
* **Music Frequency:** Adjusted to play significantly more often than vanilla settings.
* **Sound Engine:** Overwrites default biome music tags to ensure consistent playback of custom tracks.
* **Music Frequency:** If you want to constantly hear music while playing minecraft, then set the following setting to "constant".
* [Music Frequency: Constant](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3dee4dbfadec79e1e5c351e7ecf51816da97e582.png)
